# Longda's Interesting World (ilongda.com)

## Description
A technical blog covering database internals (MySQL, OceanBase), machine learning, paper reviews, and software engineering tools. Written primarily in Chinese (zh-CN).

## Author
Longda Feng — Software Engineer at OceanBase

## Content Structure
- Blog posts: https://ilongda.com/:year/:title/
- Knowledge base: https://ilongda.com/knowledge/
- MySQL articles: https://ilongda.com/mysql/
- MySQL source code analysis: https://ilongda.com/source_code_reading/
- Machine learning: https://ilongda.com/machine_learning/
- Database implementation notes: https://ilongda.com/database_implementation_reading_notes/
- Paper readings: https://ilongda.com/paper/
- Tools and utilities: https://ilongda.com/tools/
- Archives: https://ilongda.com/archives/
- Tags: https://ilongda.com/tags/
- Categories: https://ilongda.com/categories/
- About: https://ilongda.com/about/

## Content Feeds
- RSS/Atom Feed: https://ilongda.com/atom.xml
- Local Search Index (XML): https://ilongda.com/search.xml
- Full Content (plain text): https://ilongda.com/llms-full.txt
